samples.question: Each cell in every lower 3 by 3 candidate shows a stack height using 1, 2, or 3 black blocks. In the large clue card above, the three blue stacks across its top give, left to right, the maximum height in each column; the three orange stacks down its left give, top to bottom, the maximum height in each row. Exactly one candidate matches all six maxima. What is its border color: red, green, or blue?
